ext_ifname.description: Name of the external network interface (e.g., eth0, ppp0) connected to the internet.

ip_addr.description: IP address of the internal interface. If empty, auto-detected from the interface's primary address.

enable_natpmp.description: Enable NAT-PMP (NAT Port Mapping Protocol) support alongside UPnP-IGD.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0 (quiet) to 4 (debug). Higher levels increase disk and memory usage.

ssdp_broadcast_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between SSDP broadcast announcements. Smaller values = faster discovery but more traffic.

friendly_name.description: Human-readable name of the device shown to UPnP clients (e.g., in network tools).

model_name.description: Model name of the UPnP device (e.g., 'Home Router').

model_url.description: URL to product information or documentation.

manufacturer.description: Name of the manufacturer (e.g., 'Home Network Vendor').

serial_number.description: Device serial number — typically set once and never changed.

port_mappings.description: List of static port mappings to expose services to the internet. Each entry maps an external port to an internal host and port.

internal_ip.description: Internal (LAN) IP address of the target host.

internal_port.description: Port on the internal host to forward traffic to.

port_ranges.description: List of port ranges allowed for dynamic allocation (e.g., for P2P apps or gaming). Each range is allocated from start to end (inclusive).

allowed_ips.description: List of allowed internal IP addresses or CIDR subnets permitted to request port mappings. If empty, all internal IPs are allowed.
